dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: 53rd Orbital Mission: Starlink 17-36 Lifts Off from Vandenberg — 606th Booster Landing; IPO June Window Takes Shape Amid Risk Warnings
heroSubtitle: 8,761 days of SpaceX milestones — Falcon 9 B1093 (13th flight) launches 24 Starlink 17-36 satellites from Vandenberg SLC-4E at 02:42 UTC Apr 30; booster lands on OCISLY (194th landing, 606th total). Motley Fool Apr 30 flags 'historical triple whammy' for the June IPO ($75B raise, ~$1.75T, 30% retail tranche). Starship IFT-12 (Booster 19 / Ship 39 / Raptor 3 V3 stack) targeting May 2026. Constellation: 10,321 satellites in orbit serving 10M+ subscribers.
